name: Ichou no Mau Koro
source:
Yusuke Akiyama is a mediocre person.  His childhood friend Yoshizawa Makoto is like a sister to him as she takes care of him for a long time. One day Yusuke receives a love letter from a lower grade student. What kind of story awaits Yusuke upon this magnificent autumn season?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
秋山佑介是一个平庸的人。青梅竹马的吉泽诚就像妹妹一样，长期照顾他。有一天幽介收到一封来自一名低年级学生的情书。在这绚丽的金秋时节，幽介将面临怎样的故事呢？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
